snippet.title: Sonic Before the Sequel '26 - SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Sonic Before the Sequel '26 is a reimagining of the original Sonic Before the Sequel (2012), with brand new graphics, physics, and more!
The current demo contains 2 whole zones, with both Sonic and Tails playable. 

See you at SAGE 2025!
-Facundo Gomez and Usumily :3

THE DEMO IS OUT, GET IT HERE: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-before-the-sequel-26-demo-1.2724/

Huge thanks to https://www.youtube.com/@XavierClanck for making the trailer!
